title: sabina maritima
intro: Sabina maritima, commonly known as Juniperus phoenicea, is a coniferous evergreen tree native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used for its health benefits, which include its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Sabina maritima include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
